title: openOODA Package Manager
tagline: 19 subcommands. CAS-by-sha. Zero ambient supply chain. v0.7.0.
content:
## What it is

`opm` is the openOODA package manager. It ships inside the `ooda` toolchain and handles install, search, publish, lock, init, and audit for the openOODA package ecosystem. CAS-by-sha content addressing, capability declarations on every package, zero ambient supply chain.

## Install

`opm` ships with the `ooda` toolchain. Once `ooda` is on PATH, you have `opm`.

## Surface

19 subcommands, dispatched by `cli/main.oo`:

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `opm add` | Add a dependency to the manifest |
| `opm audit` | Verify installed packages against the lock |
| `opm bot` | Bot automation entry |
| `opm cat` | Print a package's manifest |
| `opm git` | Git-based source control for packages |
| `opm ingest` | Ingest a local directory as a package |
| `opm init` | Initialize a new package in the current dir |
| `opm io` | I/O introspection |
| `opm launch` | Launch a packaged application |
| `opm more` | Additional utility commands |
| `opm ops` | Operational commands (publish, retract) |
| `opm pack` | Pack a directory into a tarball |
| `opm pick` | Pick a specific version from a range |
| `opm pkg` | Package-level operations |
| `opm publish` | Publish a package to the registry |
| `opm reg` / `registry` | Registry operations |
| `opm regs` | Registry status |
| `opm search` | Search the registry |
| `opm tree` | Print the dependency tree |

Version ranges: `^1.2.3` (compatible, >=), `~1.2.3` (patch only), `1.2.3` (exact), `*` (latest). Lock file pins exact versions + content hashes.

## Version contract

```
opm=0.7.0
api_surface=10
```

Stock registry: `https://registry.openooda.org`.

See `openOODA/opm/docs/` for the full reference: `cli.oot`, `versioning.oot`, `MANIFEST.oot`, `REGISTRY.oot`, `INSTALL.oot`.
